# DergiPark

> DergiPark is Turkey's leading academic journal hosting and editorial management platform operated by TÜBİTAK ULAKBİM, providing DOI services, TR Dizin integration, and comprehensive journal management tools for Turkish and international researchers.

DergiPark serves as a centralized hub for academic publishing in Turkey, hosting peer-reviewed journals across multiple disciplines. The platform integrates with Turkish national systems (e-Devlet, TR Dizin) and international standards (ORCID, DOI) to support open-access publishing and continuous publication workflows.

- DergiPark

## Core Platform

- [Homepage](https://dergipark.org.tr/tr): DergiPark main portal providing access to Turkish academic journal hosting and editorial management
- [English Homepage](https://dergipark.org.tr/en): DergiPark international gateway for English-language access to the academic journal platform
- [About DergiPark](https://dergipark.org.tr/tr/pub/page/about): Platform overview, mission statement, and organizational structure under TÜBİTAK ULAKBİM

## Services & Features

- [DOI Service](https://dergipark.org.tr/tr/pub/page/doi-hizmeti): Digital Object Identifier service documentation with eligibility criteria and implementation guidelines for DergiPark journals
- [Subject Classification Standards](https://dergipark.org.tr/tr/pub/subjects): UKOD subject classification taxonomy and standards for organizing academic journals by discipline
- [Platform Announcements](https://dergipark.org.tr/tr/pub/announcement): System updates, feature releases, and platform changes affecting DergiPark users and journal administrators

## User & Publisher Access

- [User Account Panel](https://dergipark.org.tr/tr/user/panel): Main login and authentication portal for DergiPark user accounts with ORCID and e-Devlet integration
- [Publisher Management Panel](https://dergipark.org.tr/tr/user/publisher/panel): Administrative dashboard for journal publishers to manage submissions, issues, and journal metadata
- [Journal Editor Dashboard](https://dergipark.org.tr/tr/journal/my): Dedicated management interface for journal editors to oversee peer review, publications, and editorial workflow
- [Journal Setup Wizard](https://dergipark.org.tr/tr/journal-wizard): Guided configuration tool for new journal registration with e-Devlet and ORCID authentication support

## Account Management

- [Notification Settings](https://dergipark.org.tr/tr/user/notification): User notification preferences and alert configuration for DergiPark account activities
- [User Project Management](https://dergipark.org.tr/tr/user-project): Project-based account management and authentication for collaborative research initiatives
- [User Followers & Social Features](https://dergipark.org.tr/tr/user/user-followers): Social networking features allowing researchers to follow colleagues and track academic activities
- [Logout](https://dergipark.org.tr/tr/logout): Session termination and secure logout functionality for DergiPark user accounts

## Featured Journals

- [Balkan Music and Arts Journal](https://dergipark.org.tr/tr/pub/bmsd): Peer-reviewed open-access journal focusing on music and arts research in the Balkan region
- [Aydın Turkish Studies Journal](https://dergipark.org.tr/tr/pub/atb): Academic journal dedicated to Turkish studies, language, and cultural research
- [ITU Journal of Wireless Communications and Cybersecurity](https://dergipark.org.tr/tr/pub/itujwcc): Peer-reviewed research journal publishing advances in wireless communications and cybersecurity
- [Kafdağı Journal](https://dergipark.org.tr/tr/pub/kafdagi): Open-access humanities journal hosting interdisciplinary research and scholarly articles

## Optional

- [Development Roadmap](https://dergipark.org.tr/tr/pub/page/yol-haritasi): Planned feature updates and future development initiatives for the DergiPark platform
